title: Glutes · Build the shelf
focus: Glutes: hip extension, unilateral work and abduction
warmup: 5 min incline walk, then banded glute bridges and lateral band walks, 2 x 15 each.

exercises.name: Barbell Glute Bridge
instructions: Roll out a mat to cushion your body.
Lay flat on your back.
Roll a barbell over your legs and let it rest where your hips bend.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Stand up tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Push your hips back and lower the dumbbells, while keeping your legs straight or only slightly bent.
Return to the starting position and repeat.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Balance on one leg with opposite leg extended forward off of ground
Squat down as far as possible while keeping leg elevated off of floor
Keep supporting knee pointed same direction as foot supporting

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through
instructions: Grab the rope attachment in between your legs and face away from the cable machine.
Walk forward to remove the slack.
Drive your hips up and forward, straightening your legs. Pause and squeeze your glutes tightly, then return to the starting position.

exercises.name: Cable Kickback
instructions: Set both pulleys directly at (or slightly above) shoulder height and select the desired weight.
Grasp both handles with a neutral grip and take a step forward to split the stance.
Press the handles to lockout while flexing the pecs and extending the elbows.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction
instructions: Sit on machine with legs inside of side pads
If available, place heels on foot bars
Release and pull lever brace to position legs together

exercises.name: Dumbbell Step-Up
instructions: Instructions
Hold a pair of dumbbells at your sides and place one foot on a bench or box, your knee bent to 90 degrees
Keeping the other leg straight and firmly planted on the ground, push your  back and chest out
